output.objection: You are not going to automate my acceptance criteria just to check a box. I need those checks to stay manual so we can ship new features without waiting for a full pipeline run.
output.correction: I did not ask for a new tool or a different architecture. I simply stated that my current manual process is the bottleneck you must respect to keep our release cadence intact.
